name: Kiteling
concept: A small paper-framed glider-bird native to the Galehigh Terraces, born riding the coastal updrafts on wings of taut translucent skin stretched over hollow bone spars.
visual: Diamond kite silhouette with a tiny round head at the leading edge, cream-parchment wings edged with storm-blue, a long ribbon tail that coils in still air; reads as a kite on a string at 32px.
hook: It looks exactly like the kites the terrace farmers fly — a living toy soaring above the cliffs.

name: Galespar
concept: The fully kindled Kiteling becomes a sleek predator-kite that divebombs prey from altitude, its hollow spars crackling with accumulated static discharged on impact.
visual: Long arrowhead silhouette, wings swept back like a swept delta kite, ivory-white body with indigo lightning-stitch veins, ribbon tails split into three crackling tendrils; fast and angular at 64px.
signature_idea: Sparline Dive — builds speed charge on the turn before, then delivers a boosted Storm strike on the next.
hook: The sweet little paper kite became a lightning-veined hunter — the terrace farmers' pride turned ace.

name: Thrumvane
concept: A small, plump kin whose tail spins like a weathervane in wind; the rotation charges a static field around its body and it uses that stored charge to jam opponents' moves.
visual: Chubby oval body, stubby limbs, a broad four-blade tail that spins freely, grey-blue fur with yellow static-spark highlights at the vane tips; cute windmill shape at 32px.
hook: A living windmill with a static personality — every time it spins faster, sparks fly.

name: Thrumble
concept: A mid-stage kin whose vane-tail has grown wider and generates a continuous hum of low-frequency electricity that muddles the senses of nearby opponents.
visual: Sleeker torso, elongated limbs, tail now a six-blade fan crackling at each tip with pale yellow sparks, a thin electric halo around the body's outline; reads as actively buzzing at 48px.
hook: You can feel the hum before you see it — that constant low vibration is deeply unsettling to fight.

name: Vortavane
concept: The apex vane-beast: a tall, regal kin whose entire dorsal spine has become a bank of spinning turbine-blades, generating a tornado-like static field that blinds and staggers opponents.
visual: Upright digitigrade silhouette, dark storm-grey coat, a full spine-ridge of spinning vane-blades each trailing a spark arc, crackling eye-markings that pulse in sync with the vanes; imposing at 64px.
signature_idea: Stormfield — creates a persistent static field that has a chance to paralyse any kin that uses a contact move.
hook: The windmill grew into a roaring turbine — impossible to touch without getting shocked.

name: Cirruff
concept: A cloud-fluff pup born inside a high cirrus cloud; its fur is made of compressed cloud-stuff that crackles with soft static, and it glows faintly gold at the edges when happy.
visual: Plump round pup, fluffy white cloud-textured fur that puffs out at the paws and tail, faint gold edge-glow, two bright eyes and a tiny static-spark nose; irresistibly soft at 32px.
hook: A puppy made of cloud-fluff that sparkles — you'll want to hug it even knowing it shocks back.

name: Nimbruff
concept: The cloud-pup's fur has densified into cumulonimbus wool that flashes with internal lightning; it's cheerful but the gold-edged static halos around its body scatter light in every direction.
visual: Larger barrel-chested dog, dense grey-and-white thundercloud fur, a visible inner-glow pulsing electric-gold, long windswept ears, silver underbelly; bold presence at 48px.
hook: A golden glow behind storm-grey clouds — every battle with it feels like watching a storm roll in.

name: Cumulance
concept: The cloud-hound's final form — a great silver-and-gold stormhound whose body is a living thunderhead, radiating soft dawn-light even through the Galehigh dusk.
visual: Majestic hound silhouette, body a sculptured mass of dark-silver cloud, a blazing golden core visible through the chest, mane of vertical lightning-columns, four cloud-pad legs leaving gold hoofprints; awe-inspiring at 64px.
signature_idea: Goldstrike — a special move that targets both opposing Sp.Def and applies a Light-type radiance debuff.
hook: A cloud-puppy grew into the living heart of a thunderstorm lit from within by golden light.

name: Zappick
concept: A tiny spark-mouse that lives in the stone crevices of the Galehigh Terraces, charging itself by rubbing its wiry tail against the cliff-face until it becomes a walking static bomb.
visual: Wiry round mouse, sleek storm-grey fur spiked with static at every tip, a spring-coil tail that glows blue-white at the end, wide bright eyes; restless energy at 32px.
hook: The tiny overcharged mouse that zaps everything it touches — a walking hazard you'll adore.

name: Voltrix
concept: A sleek predatory kin grown from the spark-mouse, now capable of launching concentrated plasma bolts from the tips of its elongated coil-tipped limbs.
visual: Lean forward-leaning predator, storm-grey and electric-blue striping, four coil-tipped limbs each arcing with plasma, swept-back head-spines, long whip tail; built for pure speed and explosive power at 64px.
signature_idea: Plasma Burst — hits at high speed with a chance to ignore the opponent's Sp.Def buffs.
hook: From tiny shocking mouse to this crackling blue-streaked predator — an ambush striker that rewards the first turn.

name: Brezling
concept: A cheerful gust-finch with hollow bones so light it sometimes gets carried away by accident; it sings a rising-tone whistle that signals incoming weather to the terrace farmers.
visual: Tiny round bird, pale sky-grey body with darker wing-tips, a bright yellow-cream beak, feather-tufts that stream backward in any breeze; round quick silhouette at 32px.
hook: The little weather-bird that gets stolen by its own element — everybody roots for it.

name: Whistrak
concept: A swift gale-swallow that accelerates to shrieking speeds in strong thermals and leaves a ringing tonal trail in the air that disorients opponents.
visual: Long swept-wing swallow, pale-blue and white plumage, a forked tail edged with static-blue, a bright open-beak singing expression; pure aerial grace at 64px.
signature_idea: Resonance Shriek — reduces opponent's Speed and has a chance to confuse.
hook: A sweet little finch became a missile-fast shrieking swallow that navigates by its own sonic field.

name: Crackling
concept: A round static-beetle that clings to terrace fence-posts and discharges built-up charge in sharp pops when disturbed; the terrace children call them 'snap-bugs' and dare each other to touch them.
visual: Squat domed beetle, dark charcoal carapace, yellow-arc markings on the elytra, a tiny spark-gap gap between the wing-covers that crackles; simple dome silhouette at 32px.
hook: The snap-bug you dared your friends to touch — terrifying in miniature, irresistible to collect.

name: Stormcyte
concept: The snap-beetle fully charged — a large armoured beetle that projects a permanent crackling field, able to disrupt opponent moves with persistent electromagnetic interference.
visual: Wide beetle silhouette, jet-black carapace banded with bright yellow discharge-stripe, mandibles arcing with electricity, wings folded over a glowing gap; intimidating and geometric at 64px.
signature_idea: Jam Signal — has a chance to cancel an opponent's last-used move for the next two turns.
hook: The annoying snap-bug grew into the apex anti-mover — impossible to use your best moves against.

name: Gustwing
concept: A small crag-hopping bird with wings that are disproportionately large for its body, giving it a tumbling, erratic flight style as it surfs the cliff-face updrafts.
visual: Round body dwarfed by wide angular wings, storm-blue above and white below, short bold tail, a single bright eye visible in the compact face; looks perpetually mid-gust at 32px.
hook: Wings too big for its body — it looks like it's flying by accident, and winning by chaos.

name: Shearow
concept: A sleek mid-stage raptor that has grown into its wings and now rides thermals with precise control, using the wind to amplify the force of its diving strikes.
visual: Lean hawk silhouette, dark slate-blue dorsal plumage, white underside, swept-back head-crest, talon-tips crackling with static; controlled and alert at 48px.
hook: Watching the clumsy little wing-tumbler grow into this disciplined hunter is immensely satisfying.

name: Galecrest
concept: A magnificent storm-raptor whose every wingbeat summons a blade of compressed wind, and whose talon-strikes crackle with the electricity built during its high-altitude stoops.
visual: Large hawk silhouette with swept crescent wings, midnight-blue plumage shot with electric-silver streaks, a tall swept-back head-crest, talons wrapped in arcing plasma; commanding at 64px.
signature_idea: Wind Talon — physical Storm move that deals bonus damage proportional to the user's Speed stat.
hook: The apex of the Galehigh skies — everything below it is prey, and it knows it.

name: Sparrat
concept: A twitchy static-furred rodent that nested in old Cinderhead Mine ventilation shafts and migrated to Galehigh when the mine cooled; it stores charge in its coiled spring-tail.
visual: Small round-headed rodent, coarse grey-tan fur spiked upward by static, oversized coil-spring tail, wide startled eyes, stubby limbs always slightly airborne; comic energy at 32px.
hook: A rodent so overcharged it's practically bouncing — chaos in a small package.

name: Coilraz
concept: The twitchy spark-rodent has grown into a stocky disruptor whose coiled tail now acts as a powerful spring-launcher for electric pulses, able to arc charge across multiple opponents.
visual: Robust stoat-like silhouette, coarse striped storm-grey and pale blue fur, a tight double-helix tail tip glowing at the end, aggressive leaning stance; disruptive presence at 64px.
signature_idea: Arc Lash — hits all opponents for modest damage and has a chance to paralyse each.
hook: The chaos-rodent grew up and got organised — still chaotic, but now precisely so.

name: Puffgust
concept: A cloud-jellyfish that drifts at the height of the terrace ridgelines, trailing long translucent tentacles that act as wind-sensors; it puffs up to catch gusts and deflate to dive.
visual: Round dome body, almost translucent pale blue-grey, four trailing tentacles edged in faint yellow static dots, a simple smiling face near the top; gentle floating shape at 32px.
hook: A sky jellyfish that breathes on the same thermals as the kites — impossible not to find charming.

name: Squallveil
concept: The cloud-jellyfish kindled into a stormveil — a large, elegant airborne medusa whose trailing skirt crackles with continuous lightning that sweeps the sky in rings.
visual: Wide translucent bell-shape, storm-blue and deep purple shading, inner flash-pulse of yellow-white lightning, long fringed trailing tentacles each branching into electric filaments; dramatic and alien at 64px.
signature_idea: Lightning Skirt — damages any kin that switches into the battlefield while this kin is active.
hook: A drifting sky jellyfish became a curtain of lightning you have to walk through.

name: Quillspark
concept: A heavy-bodied cliff-porcupine whose iron-ore spines conduct and store static electricity from the surrounding air, turning each quill into a small lightning rod.
visual: Round compact body, dark iron-grey with reddish ore flecks, a back-ridge of short stubby spines each tipped in a crackle of static, tiny suspicious eyes; sturdy at 32px.
hook: A porcupine made of lightning rods — touching it from any direction is a bad idea.

name: Orequill
concept: A massive ore-porcupine whose spines have grown into heavy magnetised iron columns that arc charge between themselves in constant crackling bridges; impact attacks send a shockwave through its entire spine array.
visual: Hulking barrel silhouette, dull black iron-ore plating, a full dorsal array of tall magnetised spines each connected by arcing blue-white tendrils, small glowing eyes under a heavy brow; an immovable charged fortress at 64px.
signature_idea: Magnetite Slam — heavy physical Storm/Stone hybrid strike; if it contacts an opponent, discharges all stored static into them.
hook: The compact cliff-porcupine became a walking lightning pylon — half geological feature, half unstoppable bruiser.

name: Twixle
concept: A tiny electric-sprite insect that flickers like a loose spark; it spends its nights tracing constellations on its own as it darts between cliff-face crevices.
visual: Tiny winged sprite, body the size of a firefly, intense white-yellow core with faint storm-blue wings, a twisting sparkling flight trail, barely larger than a dot at 32px.
hook: The tiniest thing in Galehigh — a single spark given wings and a personality.

name: Lumespark
concept: The electric-sprite has kindled into a larger, brighter form whose wings emit radiant static that illuminates the terrace dusk in pulses of warm white-gold.
visual: Dragonfly-like silhouette, four wide translucent wings sparking gold at their veins, bright body of white-yellow radiance, a delicate pointed face; speed and light in one shape at 64px.
signature_idea: Gleam Dash — raises Speed and applies a brief Light-type radiant field that slightly weakens Dark-type moves.
hook: From one tiny spark to this radiant dragonfly-angel — the brightest thing in the north sky.

name: Hailwhirr
concept: A small blizzard-wasp native to the high passes above Galehigh, spinning frost crystals from its wing-tips as it spirals in updrafts; its sting is numbing cold rather than venom.
visual: Compact wasp silhouette, ice-blue and silver banding, wings that frost the air visibly as they beat, a sharp pointed abdomen tipped with a pale blue crystal stinger; crisp geometry at 32px.
hook: A winter wasp that spins ice from its wings — pretty until it stings.

name: Glacewing
concept: A mid-stage blizzard-wasp that has grown compound crystal eyes and whose wingbeats create a spiralling vortex of hail shards around its flight path.
visual: Larger angular wasp, wide iridescent frost-blue compound eyes, four wings edged with jagged ice-crystal trim, abdomen trailing a coil of hail particles; dynamic danger at 48px.
hook: The ice-vortex around it makes it look like it's already mid-attack even while resting.

name: Frigalance
concept: The apex blizzard-wasp: a slender, blade-like creature that moves through lightning-charged blizzards with total ease, delivering shots of frozen plasma that combine electric and ice damage.
visual: Long aerodynamic wasp silhouette, pale near-white with deep azure markings, a pair of blade-like crystal wings, four foreleg-lances each tipped with frozen lightning; cold elegance at 64px.
signature_idea: Sleet Lance — a special Storm/Frost hybrid move with a chance to both paralyse and freeze.
hook: Beautiful, lethal, and utterly cold — the sky's version of a thrown spear.

name: Drifthull
concept: A weather-worn, broad-bellied cloud-beast that hunches into the wind on Windward Stair; it absorbs lightning strikes into its rubbery body and re-emits them slowly as static warmth.
visual: Low broad silhouette, slate-grey rubbery hide, rounded belly, thick stubby limbs, two small glowing white eyes, faint static-crackle fringe around the edges; grounded and bulky at 32px.
hook: The unassuming grey blob that just will not go down — quietly invincible.

name: Stormhulk
concept: A massive storm-absorber that has kindled into a barrel-shaped titan; it intercepts lightning deliberately and holds the charge, releasing it in a single controlled burst once fully saturated.
visual: Enormous barrel-round silhouette, dark anvil-cloud grey, deep horizontal lightning-scar lines running around its body like contour lines, two huge steady eyes; unshakably huge at 64px.
signature_idea: Surge Release — charges for one turn, then delivers a colossal special Storm blast; power scales with damage received since last use.
hook: Let it get hit all day — then watch it pay everything back at once.

name: Gyrolin
concept: A small wind-serpent with a body like a compressed spring; it coils tight in the calm pockets between cliff faces and then launches itself skyward at terrifying speed to strike.
visual: Slender coiled serpent, pale silvery-blue scales, a pointed wedge head, two fin-like crests folded flat when coiled and spread wide in flight; minimal and tensed at 32px.
hook: The coiled spring that becomes a flying spear — all that potential energy suddenly released.

name: Spirovolt
concept: The wind-serpent fully kindled into a long, gyrating storm-snake that spirals through the air at speed, generating a plasma corona along its whole length before releasing it in a forward cone.
visual: Long spiralling serpent silhouette, deep storm-blue scales banded with electric-yellow, wing-crests spread wide and arcing with static, blazing eyes; an electric comet at 64px.
signature_idea: Coil Drive — raises Sp.Atk one stage; next Storm move deals boosted damage from the stored rotational energy.
hook: A spring became a living tornado — it spirals into the screen in a blazing helix.

name: Squallox
concept: A gust-fox kit born on the exposed upper terraces, its tail a perpetual blurred blur of motion that keeps it airborne a fraction of a second longer than it should be able to stay.
visual: Compact kit silhouette, deep azure-blue fur, four white paws, a tall pointed ear-fan on each side, a blurred fan-tail of multiple stacked ghost images; looks like it's still mid-run at 32px.
hook: The fox whose tail moves so fast it looks like it has three tails at once — speed incarnate.

name: Galefox
concept: A sleek mid-stage gust-fox who now runs so fast it creates a visible bow-wave of compressed air ahead of it; close-combat opponents are pushed back by the pressure wave before it even strikes.
visual: Lithe medium fox silhouette, deep storm-blue body fading to pale silver at the throat and belly, a single bold tail crackling at the tip, wind-distortion ripples around the paws; pure velocity at 48px.
hook: The bow-wave around it makes the ground look like it's peeling back ahead of every sprint.

name: Tempestail
concept: The apex gust-fox — a lithe, white-silver predator whose tail is now a visible thunderstorm compressed into a spinning cylinder; at full sprint its approach sounds like a breaking gale.
visual: Elegant large fox silhouette, white-silver fur with storm-blue markings, a spiralling tornado-tail that crackles with visible charge, twin ear-fins swept back; the apex of aerodynamic at 64px.
signature_idea: Gale Rush — a high-priority physical move that doubles in power if used first in a turn.
hook: The little kit that couldn't quite leave the ground became this magnificent silver storm-predator.

name: Whorlix
concept: A storm-husk kin that drifted in from the Coldfog Marches: a hollow shell of compressed dark air and residual lightning, still discharging sporadically from inside an empty void-core.
visual: Tall hollow silhouette like a funnel-cloud with a gap where the centre should be, dark ink-purple swirling walls faintly lit by trapped lightning, jagged trailing tendrils; uneasy void-shape at 48px.
signature_idea: Void Static — drains opponent's PP on the moves they use most frequently; applies confusion.
hook: A storm made of nothing — the Hollowing's mark on electricity, eerie and unforgettable.

name: Tidevolt
concept: An electric-eel kin that climbs sea-cliff waterfalls on the northern coast, generating charge from the ionised saltwater spray; it ambushes from the surf with a crackling forward lunge.
visual: Slim sinuous eel, sea-green and silver body, blue electric striping along the lateral line, a wide fan-tail that holds it upright in water; lithe hunter at 32px.
hook: An eel that climbs waterfalls by treating electricity like a ladder — wild and elegant.

name: Surgeeel
concept: A powerful electric sea-serpent that rides tidal bores up the northern inlets, discharging into the water around it; both Storm and Tide moves power it up equally.
visual: Long serpent silhouette, deep ocean-blue with bright electric-teal banding, a crested head fin and lateral fins crackling with charge, wide bright eyes; dramatic coastal apex at 64px.
signature_idea: Tidal Arc — a special Storm/Tide hybrid move that hits all opponents and gains power in rain conditions.
hook: The sea-eel that grew into a tidal lightning god — both fishers and farmers fear the storms it heralds.

name: Sparrowcaw
concept: A scrappy little terrace-sparrow that pecks spark-producing pyrite from the cliff walls and stores the flint-chips under its wing to use as a crude battery during battle.
visual: Compact passerine bird, rust-brown and dark slate-blue plumage, a puffed chest crossed by a small leather-look pouch of flint pebbles, tiny defiant eyes; cheeky and small at 32px.
hook: A sparrow that carries flint to start fires — more resourceful than it looks.

name: Flintbeak
concept: A mid-stage strike-bird whose beak has hardened into a flint-edged chisel that sparks on every strike, and whose charge builds faster the more consecutive hits it lands.
visual: Lean raptor, dark charcoal and slate-blue feathers, a dramatically elongated flint-edged beak that cracks sparks on impact, talons wrapped in static; focused aggression at 48px.
hook: The beak-as-thunderstrike concept makes every hit feel satisfying — a natural woodpecker of electricity.

name: Strikeaven
concept: The apex flint-raven: a large, sleek storm-bird whose entire beak has become a solid static-discharge rod that releases a plasma bolt on each strike; the more it attacks, the stronger each blow.
visual: Tall raven silhouette, ink-black feathers with electric-blue iridescence, a long bladed beak crackling with a continuous spark-arc, wingtips trailing static filaments; sleek and lethal at 64px.
signature_idea: Momentum Strike — deals damage that scales with each consecutive hit in a chain; chain resets if it misses or is swapped out.
hook: Each hit charges it more — a slow build into an unstoppable momentum that rewards not retreating.

name: Aethrix
concept: The Wind-Eye's hidden kin — a singular sky-sprite born at the still centre of a permanent cyclone in the sky-grotto above Galehigh. It exists in a state of calm impossibility: a being of absolute stillness surrounded by absolute chaos.
visual: Elegant humanoid silhouette, translucent wind-pale body, two wide feathered wings folded in stillness, a single rotating storm-eye marking on the chest, long flowing hair of static filaments that orbit it; serene and vast at 64px.
signature_idea: Eye of Storm — sets a unique field: all Storm-type moves used while this kin is on the field deal double power; all other moves deal half power. Lasts three turns.
hook: The dead-calm centre of a cyclone given a face — the most paradoxical and beautiful thing in the Galehigh sky.

name: Thunderoost
concept: The Thunderroost's apex bird — a legendary raptor that nests in the Windward Stair crags and whose feathers each hold a trapped lightning bolt; when it spreads its wings at dusk, the whole terrace sky lights up.
visual: Massive eagle silhouette with an enormous wingspan, white-gold primary feathers that crackle at their tips, a deep storm-blue back, a radiant light-halo crown of feather-quills, piercing twin lightning-bolt iris eyes; thunderstruck majesty at 64px.
signature_idea: Dawnstrike — a slow, very high-power Storm/Light signature move that also removes all weather and field effects on use.
hook: The bird whose wingspan lights the whole sky at dusk — the terrace farmers know it as the Lampwarden's herald.

name: Nimbit
concept: A hyperactive little sky-squirrel that glides between terrace levels using a cape of thin stretched skin, building static charge from the friction of the air as it descends.
visual: Small squirrel with wide wing-membrane flaps, pale grey body with electric-blue membrane veins, a brushy tail that flares as it glides, huge eyes for judging thermals; built for gliding at 32px.
hook: A little squirrel that charges up on the way down and unleashes it on landing — a tiny windup toy.

name: Stridepelt
concept: The glide-squirrel kindled into a lean, fast-footed sky-runner whose full wing-membranes now carry it in extended soaring bursts, and whose static-charged pelt crackles on every landing.
visual: Lean athletic squirrel silhouette, wider wing-membranes that ripple in motion, a long crackling tail, storm-blue streaks across the pale fur; always looks like it just landed at speed at 64px.
signature_idea: Glide Shock — first move of a battle is a high-priority Static charge that always paralyses if the opponent has not yet moved.
hook: The squirrel who learned to land with maximum impact — a fast support that punishes slow starters.

name: Boltwing
concept: A small, triangular-winged lightning-bat that clings to the underside of cliff ledges by day and erupts in crackling swarms at dusk, navigating by the electric sense-field of the group.
visual: Compact bat, wide angular wings, dark storm-grey body, a tiny bright-white eye each side, wing-membrane shot through with blue-white lightning veins; crisp bat silhouette at 32px.
hook: A bat-swarm that navigates by its own lightning field — the cliffs crackle at dusk when they launch.

name: Thornvolte
concept: The lightning-bat fully charged: a large, sharp-winged storm-bat whose entire frame arcs with discharge; every sonic pulse it sends out returns as a bolt of plasma.
visual: Large angular bat silhouette, midnight-blue body, wide serrated wing-edges each crackling continuously, two bright white eyes that pulse with echolocation arcs, a sharp bony crest; sleek apex bat at 64px.
signature_idea: Echo Bolt — launches a pulse that bounces between up to two targets before dissipating, hitting each for moderate Storm damage.
hook: A bat made of lightning — each sonic pulse it fires comes back as a bolt. Fighting it is fighting sound.

name: Zephyrank
concept: A colossal storm-drake that circles the upper peaks of the Windward Stair, so massive that the displacement wake from a single wingbeat topples terrace fences two levels below. Its body conducts and redirects whole storm cells.
visual: Vast dragon silhouette, deep charcoal-black scales, a wide flat head flanked by swept electrical-horn arrays, wings broad enough to blot the dusk sky, a thick whipping tail ending in a lightning-rod tip; the apex north predator at 64px.
signature_idea: Tempest Body — passive ability: any physical hit on Zephyrank has a 40% chance to paralyse the attacker from the static discharge.
hook: The drake so large it IS the storm — the thing that makes the Windward Stair famous as a danger, and you can catch it.
